dependency_notes: No unresolved project contracts. The JAXP provider must support secure processing and the external DTD access restriction. Configuration errors surface as SAXException. The caller remains responsible for closing the stream.
retrieval_notes: Both searches succeeded and each returned three exemplar chains. The shared pattern applies when caller-supplied XML can trigger external resource resolution. The implementation applies that pattern through JAXP before parsing, blocking external DTD and entity access while allowing internal DTDs subject to secure-processing limits. The JAXB, SAX, and remote GML examples informed the decision. They provide no evidence about the target class.
